adjudication.rationale: In `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`, the handler decrypts `reqBody.keys` and immediately does `JSON.parse(...)` and writes the resulting `keys` object into `prisma.credential.update/create({ data: { key: keys, ... } })` with no validation against any app-specific schema/type. The only checks are that the app slug exists in `appStoreMetadata` and that the webhook secret matches. Since downstream integrations typically expect `credential.key` to match a particular shape (often enforced via zod schemas elsewhere), storing arbitrary JSON here can later cause parsing/runtime failures when those credentials are used. This is a concrete issue present in the diff: unvalidated decrypted payload is persisted.
